Cleaning data
```{r}

analysis_df <- read_sas(here("data", "nsch2023data.sas7bdat")) %>%
  select(
    DIABETES, DIABETES_CURR,
    FOODSIT, FPL_I1:FPL_I6, ACE1,
    SC_AGE_YEARS, SC_SEX, SC_RACE_R, PHYSACTIV
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ## Outcome
    DIABETES_C = as.integer(DIABETES == 1 & DIABETES_CURR == 1),
    diabetes_status = factor(
      DIABETES_C,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No Diabetes", "Diabetes")
    ),

    ## Physical activity
    physactiv_cat = factor(
      PHYSACTIV,
      levels = 1:4,
      labels = c("0 days/week", "1–3 days/week", "4–6 days/week", "7 days/week")
    ),
    physactiv_bin = factor(
      if_else(PHYSACTIV >= 3, 1, 0),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Low (0–3 days)", "High (4–7 days)")
    ),

    ## Age groups
    age_group = cut(
      SC_AGE_YEARS,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 5, 11, 17),
      labels = c("0–5 years", "6–11 years", "12–17 years")
    ),

    ## Sex
    sex = factor(
      SC_SEX,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Male", "Female")
    ),

    ## Race/ethnicity
    race = factor(
      SC_RACE_R,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7),
      labels = c(
        "White, non-Hispanic",
        "Black, non-Hispanic",
        "AI/AN, non-Hispanic",
        "Asian, non-Hispanic",
        "NH/PI, non-Hispanic",
        "Multiracial, non-Hispanic"
      )
    ),
    race_collapsed = factor(
      case_when(
        SC_RACE_R == 1 ~ 1,
        SC_RACE_R == 2 ~ 2,
        SC_RACE_R == 4 ~ 3,
        SC_RACE_R %in% c(3, 5, 7) ~ 4
      ),
      levels = 1:4,
      labels = c(
        "White, non-Hispanic",
        "Black, non-Hispanic",
        "Asian, non-Hispanic",
        "Other/Multiracial"
      )
    ),

    ## Food security
    food_insecure = factor(
      if_else(FOODSIT == 1, 0, 1),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Never insecure", "Somewhat/Often insecure")
    ),

    ## Economic hardship (ACE)
    econ_hardship = factor(
      if_else(ACE1 <= 2, 0, 1),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Never/Rarely", "Somewhat/Very often")
    ),

    ## Poverty
    FPL_MIN = pmin(FPL_I1, FPL_I2, FPL_I3, FPL_I4, FPL_I5, FPL_I6, na.rm = TRUE),
    fpl_category = cut(
      FPL_MIN,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 100, 200, 400, Inf),
      labels = c("<100% FPL", "100–199% FPL", "200–399% FPL", "≥400% FPL")
    ),

    ## Composite hardship
    socioeconomic_status = factor(
      as.integer(FOODSIT >= 3 | ACE1 >= 3 | FPL_MIN < 100),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("High/Med status", "Lower status")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(diabetes_status),
    !is.na(PHYSACTIV),
    !is.na(SC_AGE_YEARS),
    !is.na(SC_SEX),
    !is.na(SC_RACE_R),
    !is.na(socioeconomic_status)
  )

```
